label: The First Way's mover receives its esse in no principle and has no matter and form
description: Unreceivedness of the First Way's mover, a registered intermediate distinct from pure act, firstness and necessity. Not a transcription: the conclusion's 'received in no principle' is derived by a reductio through R3, De ente and irreflexivity, none of which mentions the first mover. Establishes no premise; it reuses the premises of the existing B6 reception argument (R3, De ente, irreflexivity) at the first mover instead of R1.
